command: async (page) => await page.evaluate(async()=>{ const r=await fetch("/api/roster/team_nexus"); const d=await r.json(); return {status:r.status,lineup_ids:d.lineup_ids,effective_lineup_ids:d.effective_lineup_ids,players:d.players.map(x=>({id:x.id,stamina:x.stamina,dev_focus:x.dev_focus,training_intensity:x.training_intensity})),dom:document.querySelector("main").innerText.slice(0,3400)}; })
